name: nebula-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Nebula, a local-first security testing workbench. Its Python core
(`nebula-core`, the `nebula.v3` package under `src/nebula/`) stores engagements, evidence and content-addressed
artifacts, imports Nebula 2 engagement folders and exports engagements, and serves the assistant, knowledge,
reporting, diagnostics and setup features behind its HTTP API and command-line interface.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is Nebula 3's Python core under src/nebula/ (the nebula.v3 package, its Alembic migrations, its bundled operator help knowledge base operator_help.md and its diagnostic guidance catalog diagnostic_guidance.json) except: the command-execution and tool runtime modules agent_tooling.py, automation_runtime.py, automation_tools.py, container_terminal.py, egress_helper.py, executions.py, execution_ai.py, harnesses.py, kali_tool_inventory.py, mcp.py, mcp_gateway.py, runtime_platform.py, sandbox.py and tools.py of src/nebula/v3/, the migration template src/nebula/v3/migrations/script.py.mako and the report fonts under src/nebula/v3/report_assets/; together with README.md, the pages docs/NEBULA3.md, docs/MIGRATING-2-TO-3.md and docs/NEBULA3_DIAGNOSTICS.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
